in_sanskrit.name: शांभवी
in_sanskrit.meaning: Goddess of Knowledge, Wealth, and Prosperity
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: शां (Shaam) - Abundance, Prosperity, Wealth भ्र (Bhra) - Wisdom, Knowledge वी (Vee) - Goddess

in_hindi.name: शांभवी
in_hindi.long_meaning: शां (Shaam) - अभदिक, प्रकाशिक, समृद्धिक भ्र (Bhra) - ज्ञान, विद्या वी (Vee) - देवी, लोकेश्वरी

in_tamil.name: ஷாங்க்பிரவீ
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஷாங் (Shaang) - வெளியிட்ட, வெளியிடப்படுகிற க்பிர (Kpir) - ஜ்ஞானம், விடயம், விசயம் வீ (Vee) - அளவம், அளவையளவாளர்

in_telugu.name: షాఞ్చేబ్రవీ
in_telugu.long_meaning: షాఞ్చ (Shaangch) - అభూద, అభ్ధిశ్య, సమృద్ధిశేఖ చే (Che) - జ్ఞానము, చిద్రము బ్ర (Bru) - బధోద్ధ, బధ్య వీ (Vee) - అళ్ళభేశ్శోదరి

in_marathi.name: Shaambhravi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Knowledge and Wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shaambhravi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess Shaambhravi is the embodiment of knowledge, wisdom, and prosperity. She is often depicted with a trident and a book, symbolizing her power and her role as a teacher.

in_bengali.name: Shaambhravi
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Goddess of Knowledge and Wisdom
in_bengali.long_meaning: Shaambhravi একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Goddess Shaambhravi is the embodiment of knowledge, wisdom, and prosperity. She is often depicted with a trident and a book, symbolizing her power and her role as a teacher.
